_note: Capture universe config. Each lane selects markets from Gamma by tag; the capture daemon polls their books + trades. The shipped default records one broad liquid lane. The sample_weather strategy additionally needs the temperature ladders: copy `_example_weather_lane` into `lanes` and set real values — find tag ids via https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/tags (the daily temperature markets carry a weather tag); `date_discovery: true` lets tenant hooks (manifest `discover_event_slugs(window_days)` — the tenant owns the slug grammar; `date_discovery_cities` is the deprecated city-list alias) enumerate each day's events so tomorrow's ladders are captured as they list.
